label: Indice de aptitud agroclimatica (no es una probabilidad)
interpretation: FAO GAEZ v4 'suHr': suitability index for rain-fed (r) cropping at high (H) input level, scale 0-10000 (= 0-100 %), climate period 1981-2010, ~9 km (5 arc-minute) cells. It ranks the agro-climatic fit of a crop at the cell; it is not a yield forecast nor a probability of success, and it does not see this farm's soil or management.
classes_note: GAEZ publishes qualitative SI classes (very suitable ... not suitable); thresholds TBD (verificar fuente: FAO GAEZ v4 documentation) so only the numeric index is exposed.
source: FAO/IIASA GAEZ v4, theme 4 Suitability and Attainable Yield (suHr rasters)
